instruction: Fetch the repository https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding and save it to the /home/user folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires fetching the instructor-embedding repository to /home/user. Evaluator verifies the download was successful by checking: (1) .git directory exists, (2) repository contains at least one subdirectory, (3) InstructorEmbedding directory exists (unique to this repository), and (4) git remote URL matches the expected GitHub repository.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks all requirements - .git directory exists, correct repository via remote URL, repository-specific InstructorEmbedding directory exists, and minimum subdirectory count
Correct semantic logic: Getter extracts all necessary state (git directory, remote URL, specific subdirectories, subdirectory count) and metric performs comprehensive validation
Robust verification: Four-layer verification prevents false positives - checks git repository validity, correct remote URL, repository-specific directory structure, and completeness
Correct data flow: Getter -> Metric data flow is semantically correct with proper expected value handling (min_count from rules dictionary)
